# AgentMail (theagentmail.net)

> 100% open-source (MIT) email infrastructure for AI agents. Give every agent its own `@theagentmail.net` mailbox with sending, receiving, real-time webhooks, attachments, and an automated AI outbound spam/phishing guard. $1/month per mailbox ($5 prepaid deposit, never expires) or self-host on Cloudflare Workers.

- Website: https://theagentmail.net
- API Base URL: https://api.theagentmail.net
- Docs: https://theagentmail.net/docs
- Pricing: https://theagentmail.net/pricing
- Comparison (vs agentmail.to & DIY): https://theagentmail.net/compare
- Source Code (MIT): https://github.com/uriva/agentmail
- Support: support@theagentmail.net

## Pricing & Quotas

- **Free Trial**: 1 mailbox free for 30 days after phone verification (20 sends/day, 50 receives/day, 100 sends/mo, 200 receives/mo). Inbound signup/OTP/activation emails are blocked on free trials to prevent burner abuse and unlock immediately with a $5 deposit.
- **Paid Mailbox**: **$1/month per active mailbox** with a **$5 minimum prepaid top-up** (5 mailbox-months, funds never expire, zero platform fee). Includes 1,000 sends/month, 1,000 receives/month (200/day cap), full OTP/signup email delivery, attachments, and up to 5 real-time webhooks per mailbox.
- **Self-Hosting**: MIT licensed, runs on Cloudflare Workers + InstantDB + Resend + GCS.

## Authentication

Pass `Authorization: Bearer am_...` on every request.

1. **Org-scoped key** (`am_org_...`, created in dashboard at https://theagentmail.net/app):
   - Full org access: create/list/delete mailboxes, mint account-scoped keys, send/receive, webhooks, check balance, create Stripe checkout URLs.
2. **Account-scoped key** (`am_...`, created via `POST /v1/accounts/:accountId/api-keys` or dashboard):
   - Scoped to one mailbox (safe to give directly to an individual AI agent).
   - Supports shortcut routes without `:accountId`: `GET /v1/account`, `POST /v1/messages`, `GET /v1/messages`, `GET /v1/messages/:messageId`, `GET /v1/messages/:messageId/attachments/:attachmentId`, `POST /v1/webhooks`, `GET /v1/webhooks`, `DELETE /v1/webhooks/:webhookId`.

All success responses return `{"data": ...}`. All errors return `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`.

## Quickstart (REST API)

### 1. Create a mailbox (org key)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/accounts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_ORG_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"address": "my-agent", "displayName": "My Agent"}'
```

### 2. Mint a scoped key for the agent (org key)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/accounts/ACCOUNT_ID/api-keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_ORG_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "agent-runtime"}'
```

### 3. Send email (account key)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": ["recipient@example.com"],
    "subject": "Deploy complete",
    "text": "All checks passed."
  }'
```

Optional fields: `cc` (`string[]`), `bcc` (`string[]`), `html` (`string`), `inReplyTo` (`string`), `references` (`string`), `attachments` (`Array<{filename, contentType, content}>` with base64 `content`).

### 4. Read inbox & message body (account key)

```bash
# List messages (most recent first)
curl https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_KEY"

# Read full message body and attachment metadata
curl https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages/MESSAGE_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_KEY"

# Get 1-hour signed attachment download URL
curl https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages/MESSAGE_ID/attachments/ATTACHMENT_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_KEY"
```

### 5. Register real-time inbound webhook (account key)

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/webhooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTMAIL_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://your-agent.example.com/inbox"}'
```

Webhook deliveries POST JSON `{ "event": "email.received", "data": { "id", "account_id", "account_address", "from", "to", "cc", "subject", "text", "html", "messageId", "inReplyTo", "references", "attachments" }, "timestamp" }` signed with:
- `X-AgentMail-Signature-256`: `v1=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${rawBody}` using your webhook `secret`.
- `X-AgentMail-Timestamp`: millisecond epoch timestamp (reject if older than 5 minutes).

## Zero-Dependency TypeScript Example

```typescript
const headers = {
  Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.AGENTMAIL_KEY}`,
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

await fetch("https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages", {
  method: "POST",
  headers,
  body: JSON.stringify({
    to: ["you@example.com"],
    subject: "Build green",
    text: "Deployment finished with zero errors.",
  }),
});

const { data: messages } = await fetch("https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages", {
  headers,
}).then((r) => r.json());
```

## Zero-Dependency Python Example

```python
import os, requests

HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['AGENTMAIL_KEY']}"}

requests.post(
    "https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages",
    headers=HEADERS,
    json={
        "to": ["you@example.com"],
        "subject": "Build green",
        "text": "Deployment finished with zero errors.",
    },
).raise_for_status()

messages = requests.get(
    "https://api.theagentmail.net/v1/messages",
    headers=HEADERS,
).json()["data"]
```

## Billing Endpoints (org key)

- `GET /v1/billing/balance` -> `{"data": {"balance": 5, "admin": false, "trialUsed": true}}`
- `POST /v1/billing/checkout` -> `{"data": {"checkoutUrl": "https://checkout.stripe.com/..."}}`

## Error Codes

- `400 SPAM_REJECTED`: Outbound email blocked by real-time AI spam/phishing filter.
- `400 RESERVED_ADDRESS`: Reserved local-part (e.g. `support`, `postmaster`).
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED`: Missing or invalid Bearer token.
- `402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` / `ACCOUNT_EXPIRED`: Top up prepaid balance at https://theagentmail.net/app.
- `403 FORBIDDEN` / `PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`: Wrong token scope or phone not verified.
- `409 ADDRESS_EXISTS`: Mailbox address already taken.
- `429 SEND_LIMIT_REACHED` / `DAILY_SEND_LIMIT_REACHED`: Quota exceeded.
